provider: CUHK Department of Cultural and Religious Studies 2025-26 Public Humanities Major Programme Requirement and Course List
note: The intake-specific 2025-26 Study Scheme publishes a 66-unit standard Major and a 51-unit senior-entry Major. The standard Major includes a 9-unit Faculty Package, 18 units of Required Courses and 39 units of Elective Courses, with optional Cultural Management or Cultural Studies concentrations. This supplement exposes all 88 courses in the Study Scheme course table, including the two named CURE Faculty Package choices, seven fixed or choice-based Required/Capstone courses, the Public Humanities Workshop, and eight Cultural Studies/Cultural Management Areas. It does not import the remaining cross-department Faculty Package choices or the complete Religious Studies Areas pool required by the standard path. The current department Course List differs from the intake-specific Study Scheme at CURE2024/CURE2404 and CURE3031/CURE3013, and calls CURE3408 Curating and Organizing Arts Festival while the Study Scheme calls it Curating and Managing Arts Festival; this supplement preserves the intake-specific Study Scheme codes and titles. The nine/eight-course area rules, at-least-seven-CURE rule, course reuse exclusions and concentration substitutions require manual review. The resulting list is intentionally browse-only and must not be presented as a complete 66-unit graduation audit.
